<thought>Validated that the SMILES "C=C(C)C(=O)OCC" corresponds to a C₇H₁₀O₂ ester with a carbonyl at ~161 ppm, two olefinic carbons at ~144 and ~130 ppm, and four aliphatic carbons, matching the observed 13C NMR and the molecular ion (M+H⁺ ≈ 127). This is the most plausible structure.</thought>
<final_answer>C=C(C)C(=O)OCC</final_answer>
